propositions: Nested retries across subprocess/SDK/wrapper cause timeout multiplication and ambiguous Jira write acceptance; a single provider-neutral retry budget is required to establish one logical outcome contract
Cloud and DC summary updates must guarantee at most three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep with bounded redacted diagnostics and replay-safe recovery
Jira SDK lacks idempotency keys; recovery must observe desired state before replay, with satisfactory post-timeout observations returning success without additional writes
DC executor must be built with jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0) and fail fast if _session.max_retries != 0; selected wrapper calls enforce one-attempt/no-sleep policy

Each terminal outcome records exactly one redacted per-mutation message (≤512 code points), advances no baseline/provenance, and logs one completion event (≤1,024 code points) with only logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, and retry_not_before
Handler maintains legacy result shapes (_fields_synced, _comment_errors, _subop) for confirmed outcomes; S3 owns venue-gated default cutover and S5 owns live confirmation
